title: Prime Tax & Accords
subtitle: Arithmetical advantage for prime wanderers
description: Landing on prime numbered tiles bestows great prestige, whereas common tiles carry lower reward.
author: Chief Magistrate Euclid

rules.title: Prime Tile Bounty
rules.original_text: When a player lands on a prime-numbered tile, give them 2 extra points.
rules.normalized_rule: Landing on prime tile yields +2 score.
rules.readable_meaning: On land: If tile is prime (2, 3, 5, 7, 11...), award +2 points to active player.

rules.title: Even Roll Bonus
rules.original_text: If the active player rolls an even number, award 1 bonus point.
rules.readable_meaning: On roll: If dice sum is even (2, 4, 6, 8...), award +1 point to rolling player.
